content.value: . A mixture of ideal gases consists of 5 Kg of nitrogen and 6 Kg of carbon dioxide at a pressure of 4 bar and a temperature of 27 °C. Find: (i) The mole fraction of each constituent, (ii) The equivalent molecular weight of the mixture, (iii) The equivalent gas constant of the mixture, and (iv) The volume and density of the mixture.
